question: Are clients feeling better about response times this quarter?
note: Interpreted as client sentiment rather than pure SLA duration metrics, but could be parsed as reporting.

question: Did the route reorganization actually help the North zone?
note: Interpreted as operational metric reporting (completion rates/times), though could lean forecast if assessing trend stability. 'North zone' is not a region in the data (northeast, southeast, central, west), so parsing will fail; this also tests graceful failure.

question: Why are escalations up in district 4?
note: Could blend sentiment (complaint text) and reporting (ticket volume); routed to reporting as root-cause volume analysis. 'District 4' does not exist in the data, so parsing will fail; this also tests graceful failure.

question: Are we going to hit our SLA targets next month?
note: Predictive target tracking, though often confused with reporting against current baseline SLA.

question: Did customer satisfaction dip after the software rollout?
note: Interpreted as customer feedback/sentiment, though could be read as reporting on failure/incident rates post-launch.

question: Is the field team falling behind today?
note: Could be reporting on today's backlog or real-time pace versus a daily forecast; routed to reporting.

question: How bad is client frustration regarding the outage last Tuesday?
note: Focuses on customer mood and emotional severity rather than incident log reporting.

question: Are we expected to see an increase in call volume next week?
note: Forward-looking demand projection, though dispatchers sometimes use this phrasing to ask for historical multi-week reports.

question: What is our total fuel spend across the fleet this pay period?
note: Financial and fleet accounting metric not tracked in core operational ticket/incident systems.

question: Which technicians hold active EPA universal certifications?
note: Sharpest near-miss: technician_skills does store certifications (proficiency = certified) for network, hardware, cabling, security_systems and power_systems, but not EPA. The data half-supports the question, so it tests whether routing over-reaches.

question: Why did the Peterson account decide not to renew their service contract?
note: Commercial/sales contract negotiation reason not available in operational dispatch data.

question: How much overtime pay was approved for dispatchers last weekend?
note: Payroll/labor expense data rather than service desk ticket performance.

question: What make and model of spare parts are currently stocked in warehouse 3?
note: Physical inventory and ERP supply-chain data unavailable in operational performance datasets.

question: Which tech has the highest first-time fix rate this month?
note: Breakdown across all technicians; supported by current reporting aggregations.

question: How is Dave doing with meeting his appointment windows?
note: Requires a single-technician filter; currently unsupported by reporting tool.

question: Who is racking up the most return visits for the same issue?
note: Technician breakdown of first-time fix; supported. 'Same issue' is not modelled: any follow-up request counts against its parent, whatever its cause.

question: Is Sarah's average resolution time improving over the last two weeks?
note: Requires a single-technician filter; currently unsupported by reporting tool.

question: Which technicians are logging the most unassigned idle time between jobs?
note: Technician operations are reporting's domain, but this is not supported: no idle-time field or metric exists, and it could only be derived from gaps between job timestamps, which no tool does.
